jp: {voice:001814}ガーロット！{n}城外に布陣する部隊を捕捉したわ！
en: Garlot! I've spotted units deployed outside the walls!

jp: {voice:001914}部隊の数が少ないね。{n}少数精鋭って感じもしないし。
en: Not many of them. And they don't look like a small elite force either.

jp: {voice:001A14}なんとなく浮き足立っているな。{n}カローナの軍とは大違いだ。
en: They seem kind of jumpy. Nothing like Karona's army.

jp: {voice:001B14}電撃戦で虚を衝けたせいか？
en: Maybe our lightning strike caught them off guard?

jp: {voice:001C14}いえ、それらを踏まえても状況は{n}合理的ではありませんね。{n}警戒は怠らぬように。
en: No, even allowing for that, the situation is not rational. Do not let your guard down.

jp: {voice:001D14}それはさておき、{n}手前の柵が問題ですね。{n}あれらを取り除かなければ……
en: That aside, the fences in front are a problem. We must remove them...

jp: {voice:001E14}これが王都パルティナ…
en: So this is the royal capital, Paltina...

jp: {voice:001F14}姉さん、もうすぐです……
en: Sister, we are almost there...

jp: {voice:002014}ねえ、ダンチョーお兄ちゃん。{n}まだ戦いは始めないの？
en: Hey, Big Brother Captain. Aren't we starting the battle yet?

jp: {voice:002114}もうすぐだ。{n}増援が出てきたら{n}手に負えなくなるからな。
en: Soon. If reinforcements come out, we won't be able to handle it.

jp: {voice:002214}早く戦いたいな。{n}敵を倒せばいいんだよね？
en: I want to fight soon. I just have to beat the enemies, right?

jp: {voice:002314}だからさ、早く始めようよ！{n}ねえ、ダンチョーお兄ちゃん、{n}早く早く～！
en: So, y'know, let's hurry and start! Hey, Big Brother Captain, hurry, hurry~!

jp: {voice:002414}あら？{n}城門の上に出てきた人……{n}以前会っているわね。
en: Oh? That person who came out on top of the castle gate... I've met him before.

jp: {voice:002514}ウルズ・ティアを強奪した時に{n}出てきた大臣じゃないか？
en: Isn't that the minister who showed up when we stole Urd's Tear?

jp: {voice:002614}あの男は、神生教団の教祖だ。
en: That man is the Pontiff of the Blessed Papal Army.

jp: {voice:002714}本当か？
en: Really?

jp: {voice:002814}ああ、普段顔は見せないが、{n}あの雰囲気、そうだと感じる。
en: Yes. He does not usually show his face, but that air about him. I sense it is him.

jp: {voice:002914}あれが、黒幕！
en: So that is the mastermind!

jp: {voice:002A14}もう１人は、誰かな？{n}女の子みたいだけど、{n}アイギナに少し似てるね……
en: Who's the other one, I wonder? Looks like a girl, and she looks a little like Aegina...

jp: {voice:002B14}まさか、王女ユグドラか②
en: Don't tell me that's Princess Yggdra!!

jp: {voice:002C14}って事は…、{n}ルシエナとアイギナの妹？
en: So that means... She's Luciana and Aegina's little sister?

jp: {voice:002D14}妹とは思いません！{n}私達の犠牲の上に王家の寵愛を{n}一身に受けて育った、嫌な女です②
en: She is no sister of mine! A hateful girl, raised on all the royal favor at the price of our sacrifice!!

jp: {voice:002E14}そんなに怒鳴らなくても……
en: You don't have to yell about it...

jp: {voice:002F14}あの軍勢は一体？
en: Who is that army?

jp: {voice:003014}帝国の軍でございますよ、姫様。
en: That is an army of the Empire, Princess.

jp: {voice:003114}とは言っても、どこかの正規軍{n}ではなく、荒くれ者の徒党。{n}つまり賊軍でございます。
en: Though not anyone's regular army, but a gang of ruffians. In short, an army of bandits.

jp: {voice:003214}まったく……{n}暴れるなら自分の国で暴れれば{n}よいものを。
en: Honestly... If they wish to run wild, they could do it in their own country.

jp: {voice:003314}つまりあの軍勢は、王国に{n}戦争を仕掛けてきたのですね？{n}なんてひどいことを！
en: So that army has come to wage war on the Kingdom? How terrible!

jp: {voice:003414}さらに連中、言うにこと欠いて…{n}いや、さすがに私の口から{n}これを言うのは、恐れ多い。
en: What's more, those people have the gall to... No, this is too dreadful for me to say.

jp: {voice:003514}なんですか？{n}言ってください、アランゼーム。
en: What is it? Please tell me, Alanjame.

jp: {voice:003614}実はその…、姫様の姉と名乗り、{n}あろうことか、我が王家の{n}王位継承権を主張しているのです。
en: Well, the truth is... They call one of them your sister, and she dares to claim the throne of our royal house.

jp: {voice:003714}そんな言いがかり…{n}ひどい……
en: Such a false accusation... How terrible...

jp: {voice:003814}それは成敗されるべきです。{n}聖剣の義の名の下に……
en: They must be punished. In the name of the Holy Sword's justice...

jp: {voice:003914}姫様……{n}そろそろお城に戻りましょう。
en: Princess... Let us return to the castle now.

jp: {voice:003A14}戦闘が始まります。{n}姫様に矢傷でもつきましたら、{n}陛下に申し訳が立ちませぬゆえ。
en: The battle is about to begin. If an arrow were to graze you, I could never face His Majesty.

jp: {voice:003B14}わかりました……{n}平穏な日々が一刻も早く戻るよう、{n}尽力をお願いします。
en: Very well... Please do your utmost, so that peaceful days return as soon as possible.

jp: {voice:003C14}よし、大砲の用意を！{n}軽くあしらってやれ、軽～くな②
en: Very well, ready the cannons! Give them a light brushing off, nice and light!!

jp: {voice:003D14}おいおい、{n}大砲の用意を始めやがった②
en: Hey, hey, they've started readying cannons!!

jp: {voice:003E14}あら？　あの大砲……{n}結構な上物を使っているわね。
en: Oh? Those cannons... They're using some pretty fine goods.

jp: {voice:003F14}羨ましい！　王国は、火器武装に{n}理解があっていいわね。{n}帝国とは大違いね。
en: I'm so jealous! The Kingdom really gets firearms, how nice. So unlike the Empire.

jp: {voice:004014}そんな暢気な事、{n}言ってる場合じゃないだろ！{n}城壁の上じゃ攻撃もできない。
en: This is no time to be so laid-back! We can't even attack them on top of the wall.

jp: {voice:004114}ボクが行くよ！{n}ボクなら城壁の上だって、{n}カンタンに越えて行けるから②
en: I'll go! I can fly over the castle wall, no problem!!

jp: {voice:004214}あ、コラ！　指示を聞け②
en: Ah, hey! Listen to orders!!

jp: {voice:004314}でもさ、正直助かるわ。{n}上から大砲で狙い撃ちされたら、{n}対処できないじゃん？
en: But honestly, that's a big help. If they pick us off with cannons from up there, we can't do a thing, right?

jp: {voice:004414}そうだね。{n}大砲はエミリオに任せて、{n}僕らは城門の突破に集中しよう！
en: True. Leave the cannons to Emilia, and we'll focus on breaking through the gate!

jp: {voice:004514}エミリオさんは、{n}大丈夫でしょうか……
en: Will Emilia-san be all right...

jp: {voice:004614}信じるしかねぇよ。{n}俺達は、増援が来る前に地上軍を{n}撃破させないとな②
en: We just have to trust her. We need to smash the ground troops before reinforcements come!!

jp: {voice:004714}よいしょ、到着～。
en: Oof, I'm here~.

jp: {voice:004814}んっ…！　敵がこんな所に！{n}狙いは大砲なの？
en: Huh...! An enemy, up here! Is she after the cannons?

jp: {voice:004914}……予期した通りだ。{n}これもまた天意。
en: ...Just as foreseen. This too is Heaven's will.

jp: {voice:004A14}しまった、伏兵か！{n}大砲はエミリオを誘き出す{n}罠だったのか②
en: Damn it, an ambush! So the cannons were a trap to lure Emilia out!!

jp: {voice:004B14}うほっ②{n}してやられた、って感じだわさ！
en: Whoa!! Looks like they got one over on us!

jp: {voice:004C14}あれは、神生教団の兵士……
en: Those are Blessed Papal Army soldiers...

jp: {voice:004D14}私も知らされていなかったが、{n}やはり王国と神生教団は{n}結びついていたようだな……
en: I was not told, but it seems the Kingdom and the Blessed Papal Army are indeed connected...

jp: {voice:004E14}なーんだ。{n}人数が少ないんだね。{n}ガッカリしちゃったよ。
en: Aw, is that all. There aren't many of you. How boring.

jp: {voice:004F14}手応えなさそうだから、{n}ガッカリしてるの……{n}さっさと片付けちゃおーっと。
en: You don't look like much fun, so I'm bored... I'll just finish this up quick.

jp: {voice:005014}なんなのよ、この小娘……{n}こんな子供に、どうしろって……
en: What's with this little girl... What am I supposed to do against a child like this...

jp: {voice:005114}キャァァァァァァァァァァ②
en: Eeeeeeeeeeeek!!

jp: {voice:005214}大砲、いただきまーす。
en: I'll take these cannons, thanks.

jp: {voice:005314}エミリオはやはり強い。{n}あんな幼い子供なのに……
en: Emilia really is strong. And she's such a little kid...

jp: {voice:005414}ダンチョーお兄ちゃん！{n}大砲を奪ったよ？
en: Big Brother Captain! I took the cannons, okay?

jp: {voice:005514}でかしたぜ、エミリオ②{n}あとは俺達に任せとけよ！
en: Nice going, Emilia!! Leave the rest to us!
Oka~y.

jp: {voice:005714}全員片付いたか？
en: Did we take care of all of them?

jp: {voice:005814}増援の気配もありません。{n}門を破るなら今です！
en: There is no sign of reinforcements either. If we are to break the gate, it must be now!

jp: {voice:005914}よしッ、力ずくでブチ破るぞ②
en: All right, we're smashing it down by force!!

jp: {voice:005A14}開いた！　ここから城内に②
en: It's open! We go into the castle from here!!

jp: {voice:005B14}待て、アイギナ！{n}一度城外で隊列を整えるんだ！
en: Wait, Aegina! We're forming up outside the walls first!

jp: {voice:005C14}そうだね。{n}城内は奴らの居城なんだ。{n}警戒し過ぎる事はないよ。
en: That's right. Inside's their home ground. We can't be too careful.

jp: {voice:005D14}…はい。
en: ...Yes.

jp: {voice:005E14}みんなー、ボク頑張ったよぉ！{n}褒めて褒めて～！
en: Everyone~, I did my best! Praise me, praise me~!

jp: {voice:005F14}よく頑張ったわね、エミリオ。{n}あなたのおかげで、{n}被害は最小限に食い止められたわ。
en: You did great, Emilia. Thanks to you, we kept our losses to a minimum.

jp: {voice:006014}えへへ～。{n}ボク、まだまだやれるよー。
en: Hehe~. I can still keep going, you know.

jp: {voice:006114}なんとかここまで来れたな。{n}ネシアの戦略とジェノンの戦術が{n}上手くいっている。
en: We somehow made it this far. Nessiah's strategy and Jenon's tactics are working out.

jp: {voice:006214}僕もこんなにうまく事が運ぶとは{n}正直思ってなかったよ。
en: Honestly, I never thought things would go this well either.

jp: {voice:006314}らしくないじゃん。{n}せっかく褒められてんだから、{n}いつもみたいに調子に乗ったら？
en: That's not like you. Now that someone's praising you, why not get carried away like usual?

jp: {voice:006414}驚いているのさ。{n}ただの一計で国が覆るなんて、{n}俄かには信じられない。
en: I'm surprised, is all. A whole country flipping over just one scheme, it's hard to believe.

jp: {voice:006514}確かにそうね～{n}ま、パメラ様が成功率を底上げ{n}してるのは間違いないけどね♪
en: True enough~. Well, there's no doubt Pamela-sama is boosting our odds of success, though♪

jp: {voice:006614}私もそれが気になっていました。{n}いくらなんでも、脆過ぎる。
en: That has been bothering me as well. No matter how you look at it, it was too fragile.

jp: {voice:006714}これほど単純に城門を突破できる{n}など、通常は考えられません。
en: Breaking through a castle gate this simply would ordinarily be unthinkable.

jp: {voice:006814}確かにそう言われれば、{n}防衛の兵力も常識から考えると{n}少なかった。
en: Now that you mention it, they did have fewer defenders than you'd expect.

jp: {voice:006914}俺達を侮っていただけじゃ{n}ないのか？
en: Weren't they just underestimating us?

jp: {voice:006A14}もしくは、何かの誘いか？
en: Or is it some kind of lure?

jp: {voice:006B14}……団長。
en: ...Captain.

jp: {voice:006C14}どうした、ジルヴァ？
en: What's wrong, Zilva?

jp: {voice:006D14}アイギナの姿が見当たらない。
en: I cannot find Aegina.

jp: {voice:006E14}アイギナが？{n}まさかアイツ、１人で…！
en: Aegina? Don't tell me she's gone in alone...!

jp: グラムブレイズ
en: Gram Blaze

en: Army

en: Army

en: Papal
